name: ladi-pop
brief: A small Diwali firecracker pop explosion effect at ground level, side view, wider than tall: a jagged white-hot and bright yellow starburst flash in the middle, short marigold-orange spark streaks shooting up and out, a few small torn red paper confetti scraps flying outward, a small round grey-white smoke puff starting at the bottom. Flat bottom edge where it touches the ground. Hard-edged chunky pixel effect with a few hard colour steps, no soft glow, no gradients. ONLY the explosion: no cracker, no object, no character.
subject: prop
